Class Game

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Game extends Object implements Serializable
Core game model. Holds all mutable state for a single match: players, board, current round/era, current player, and phase.

Notifies registered GameObservers on every state change and EndGameObservers when the game ends. Observer lists are transient and rebuilt after deserialisation via setupTransientAttributes().

Two constructors are provided: one for new games, one for games recovered from serialised state (the recovered constructor sets isInitialized to true to skip board setup in InitGameState).

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(int gameId, int numPlayer)
      Creates a new, uninitialised game. The board is set up later by InitGameState (signalled via isInitialized = false), the match starts at round 1, era 1, with no players, current player, or phase yet assigned.
      Parameters:
      gameId - unique identifier of this game session
      numPlayer - maximum number of players allowed in this game

    • Game

      public Game(int gameId, int numPlayer, int round, int era, Set<Player> players, Player currentPlayer, Board board, Phase phase)
      Reconstructs a game from persisted state after a server crash or restart. Sets isInitialized to true so InitGameState skips board setup. Observer lists start empty and must be repopulated via setupTransientAttributes() and addVirtualClient(VirtualClient).
      Parameters:
      gameId - unique identifier of this game session
      numPlayer - maximum number of players allowed in this game
      round - the round the game was on when persisted
      era - the era the game was on when persisted
      players - the players in the match
      currentPlayer - the player whose turn it was, or null
      board - the persisted board state
      phase - the phase the game was in when persisted

    • sendEndGameResults

      public void sendEndGameResults(List<MatchResult> results, List<DBRecord> records, String message)
      Broadcasts end-of-game data with an optional log message.
      Parameters:
      results - per-player final scores; null if never started
      records - all-time leaderboard; empty when no DBMS is available
      message - log line shown in the client end-game screen

    • setupTransientAttributes

      public void setupTransientAttributes()
      Reinitialises transient fields after deserialisation. Must be called on every recovered Game before it is registered with a controller.
